meta.description: Pay an invoice, deposit, or retainer securely. Open your payment link, check the figures, and pay by card — handled by Stripe.

footer.tagline: Pay an invoice, deposit, or retainer securely. Run from {location}.
footer.secured: Card details are handled by Stripe — they never touch this server.

home.title: Pay your invoice, securely.
home.intro: Open the payment link from your invoice email to see the figures and pay by card. There's nothing to set up — the link takes you straight to the right invoice. If you don't have a link, just reply to my email and I'll send one over.

assurances.title: You pay against a real invoice
assurances.description: Every payment link is tied to an invoice I've already sent you — same number, same amount. Nothing is quoted or added here.

assurances.title: Card details go straight to Stripe
assurances.description: The card form is Stripe's, embedded on the page. Your details never touch my server, and the payment is SCA-ready.

assurances.title: You get a receipt, I get notified
assurances.description: Stripe emails you a receipt the moment it clears, and the invoice is marked paid — no chasing, no back-and-forth.

pay.cardsToStripe: Card details go straight to Stripe.

paid.title: This invoice is paid
paid.description: Nothing more to do — thank you. A receipt was sent to you by email when it cleared.

notOpen.title: This invoice isn't open for payment
notOpen.description: If you think this is a mistake, reply to my email and I'll sort it out.

checkout.notConfiguredBefore: No Stripe publishable key is set, so the card form isn't mounted. Add Stripe keys to

complete.title: Payment received — thank you
complete.descriptionWithEmail: Your payment cleared, and a receipt is on its way to {email}. The invoice is now marked paid; there's nothing more to do.
complete.description: Your payment cleared. The invoice is now marked paid; there's nothing more to do.

open.title: Payment not completed
open.description: The payment was cancelled or didn't go through. You can try again — nothing has been charged.

unknown.title: We couldn't confirm this payment
unknown.description: If you completed a payment, you'll still get a receipt by email. Otherwise, head back to the invoice to try again.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that invoice.
notFound.intro: The payment link might be old, mistyped, or already settled. Reply to my email and I'll send you a fresh one.
